description: M5 agents UI (ADR 0013 §11): editor and Settings windows read the MCP relay status and connections, disconnect agents, toggle HTTP, rotate host tokens, run the installer's config reads/writes, read activity, edit policies, start/stop/restart the server, read and set its settings (start on launch, HTTP port), check a port, read a host's bearer, read and reveal the server log, and emit approval answers to the document host. The relay's host-side commands are not granted here.
